note: Every top-level integer constant in every backend gate script, with the direction it may move. check:baseline-integrity fails on an unregistered constant (which is what a rename looks like), a stale registration (the other half of a rename), and any move in the unsafe direction. ratchet = may only decrease. floor = may only increase; lowering a floor is how a gate goes blind while printing OK. pinned = may not change without re-registering, used where the safe direction is genuinely not obvious.

ACTIONABLE_UNDETECTED_BASELINE.reason: Introduced by c0daca5b while UNDETECTED_CLAIM_BASELINE went 2 -> 0 in the same file: net 2 -> 3. That net raise is the reason this gate exists, and it is recorded here rather than argued away.

MAX_HOPS.reason: New constant, not a rename — registered 2026-09-04 when this gate's reach went from 2 of 336 paginated GETs to the whole corpus. It caps how many times the payload classifier will follow a return expression through a callback wrapper (runInTenantTransaction, cachedVersioned, withTenant and friends) before giving up and reporting `unresolved`. A ratchet because RAISING it is the dangerous direction: a deeper walk resolves more handlers and so makes the gate look better without any code improving, and an unbounded walk would recurse on a cyclic re-export. Lowering it is safe — it only turns resolved handlers back into honestly-unresolved ones.

LIMIT.reason: CLAUDE.md §7's hard review limit. Policy, not debt; raising it would retire the rule by arithmetic.

MIN_FILES.reason: Anti-vacuity floor on files scanned. RAISED 50 -> 2000 and banked 2026-09-03 by v2 ticket 30. A tightening: the old 50 was 1.4% of the 3,606 scannable files and was proved in a tmpdir to let an unreadable src/modules through with a clean pass. Measured at head: 3,574 files scanned.

MIN_GATES.reason: Anti-vacuity floor on the number of check:* gates the matcher resolves. RAISED 60 -> 90 and banked 2026-09-03 by v2 ticket 30. Raising a floor is a TIGHTENING, not a raise to turn a regression green: it forces the scan to reach more before it may report clean. Measured at head: 99 gates resolved, so the floor sits ~9% below with no slack for a matcher that stops resolving.

MIN_JOBS.reason: Anti-vacuity floor on jobs resolved. NOT a rename of MIN_GATES and not a raise: it measures a different dimension, and before 2026-09-03 it was unregistered rather than lower. A workflow ruled unreachable, or a jobs: block that stops parsing, drops this number -- which is the failure mode it exists to catch. Measured at head: 15 jobs.

MIN_RUN_STEPS.reason: Anti-vacuity floor on run: steps resolved. Same reasoning as MIN_JOBS: a new dimension, registered rather than raised. Measured at head: 160 run steps.

MIN_CREDENTIAL_LENGTH.reason: Minimum length a matched string must have to be called a credential. Raising it makes the detector match fewer strings, so the safe direction is down.

RESPONSE_SCHEMA_UNCOVERED_CEILING.owner: every module lane that owns a controller; coordinated by the API contract owner (ticket 04)
RESPONSE_SCHEMA_UNCOVERED_CEILING.reason: Operations declaring NO response body schema. Registered 2026-09-03 by v2 ticket 30 at the TRUE measured figure, 3,617 of 3,642 uncovered (25 covered, 0.69%). The gate previously required 100% and reported 3642/3642 (100%) -- because its predicate accepted a bare 2xx response KEY, which NestJS auto-generates with no content for every handler, so the condition was true for every operation the moment the document was generated. Actual coverage of the property it claimed was 1 in 3,642 (0.027%). This is NOT a baseline raised to turn a regression green: it is the first honest measurement of a number that was never measured, and the 100%% requirement was NOT restored only because demanding it would red the pipeline on ~3,617 handlers across every module lane. Lower it as coverage lands; raising it retires the rule by arithmetic.

LOWERED BACK to 392 and banked 2026-09-03 by v2 ticket 30 as ticket 37's splits landed. RE-MEASURED at head: 388 of 3,646 production files, four BELOW the ratchet, gate exit 0. PROVIDER_REACH_MAX_DEPTH.reason: Traversal depth cap for provider reach. Registered PINNED, not as a ratchet or a floor, by v2 ticket 30 on 2026-09-03: ticket 30 does not own this script and did not reason about which direction is safe here, and `pinned` is the honest default -- it asserts no direction and forces whoever changes the constant to re-register it with a direction and a reason. Lowering it shrinks the corpus the gate reaches, which is the vacuity risk; raising it only costs time. Reclassify when the owning ticket lands.

CONDITIONAL_BASELINE.reason: Runtime-selected describes gated on DATABASE_URL / APP_DATABASE_URL / a provider key. Honest skips, each with a registered blocker. RE-REGISTERED 28 -> 29 on 2026-09-03 for src/modules/chat/__tests__/chat-send-conflict-target.db.spec.ts, the regression net for the 42P10 that made every POST /chat/channels/:id/messages return 500 at journal head. Its CATALOG half is gated on CHAT_DB_TESTS=1 because index inference happens inside Postgres at PLAN time and only a real catalog can observe it; its HERMETIC half is unconditional and would alone have caught the defect. Verified before signing off, not asserted: run against a local partial index (scratch_gates_head) the full spec is 7/7 green, 3 of those in the always-on half. A raise here is a debt increase and must stay exceptional -- the next request to raise it should retire an existing conditional site instead.

MAX_SUPPRESSED_UNBOUNDED.reason: Unbounded reads hidden behind a FALSE-POSITIVE verdict, counted as instances. A verdict is keyed per FILE and carries one sentence, so a read added to an already-blessed file inherits a justification never written about it — /clients/clients.service.ts' unbounded CSV export of every client in the org sat under 'client reads bounded by clientId+orgId (single-record lookups)' and no other check in the gate moved. Measured at 651 with no headroom; lower it when you bound a read, and raising it means naming the newly hidden read here.

Ticket 30 registered the direction, not the number: it does not own this gate. Lower bound on ON CONFLICT sites the scan must find.
